## Task 1 – Faculty Salaries Graph

```{r task1-faculty-salaries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)

# Load, clean, and keep only Tier I, IIA, IIB
fac_raw <- read_csv("FacultySalaries_1995.csv") |>
  clean_names() |>
  filter(tier %in% c("I", "IIA", "IIB"))

# Pivot the three salary columns
fac_long <- fac_raw |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      avg_full_prof_salary,
      avg_assoc_prof_salary,
      avg_assist_prof_salary
    ),
    names_to = "rank",
    values_to = "salary"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rank = case_when(
      rank == "avg_assist_prof_salary" ~ "Assist",
      rank == "avg_assoc_prof_salary"  ~ "Assoc",
      rank == "avg_full_prof_salary"   ~ "Full"
    ),
    rank = factor(rank, levels = c("Assist", "Assoc", "Full")),
    tier = factor(tier, levels = c("I", "IIA", "IIB"))
  )

# Plot
ggplot(fac_long, aes(x = rank, y = salary, fill = rank)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ tier, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Assist" = "#F8766D",
      "Assoc"  = "#7CAE00",
      "Full"   = "#00B0F6"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Rank",
    y = "Salary",
    fill = "Rank"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 14)
  )
```

## Task 2 – ANOVA Model

```{r task2-anova, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Prepare data for ANOVA
anova_data <- fac_long |>
  mutate(
    state = as.factor(state),
    tier  = as.factor(tier),
    rank  = as.factor(rank)
  )

# ANOVA: Salary explained by State, Tier, Rank (no interactions)
salary_aov <- aov(salary ~ state + tier + rank, data = anova_data)

# Show ANOVA summary
summary(salary_aov)
```

## Task 3 – Load and Tidy Juniper Oils Data

```{r task3-tidy-juniper, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)

# Load & clean
jun_raw <- read_csv("Juniper_Oils.csv") |>
  clean_names()

# List of chemical columns from the exam
chemicals <- c(
  "alpha_pinene","para_cymene","alpha_terpineol","cedr_9_ene","alpha_cedrene","beta_cedrene",
  "cis_thujopsene","alpha_himachalene","beta_chamigrene","cuparene","compound_1","alpha_chamigrene",
  "widdrol","cedrol","beta_acorenol","alpha_acorenol","gamma_eudesmol","beta_eudesmol",
  "alpha_eudesmol","cedr_8_en_13_ol","cedr_8_en_15_ol","compound_2","thujopsenal"
)

# Pivot to tidy long format
jun_long <- jun_raw |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(chemicals),
    names_to = "chemical_id",
    values_to = "concentration"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    chemical_id = gsub("_", "-", chemical_id)
  )
```

## Task 4 – Chemical Concentrations vs. Years Since Burn

```{r task4-juniper-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(jun_long, aes(x = years_since_burn, y = concentration)) +
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, color = "blue") +   # smooth line + gray ribbon, no points
  facet_wrap(~ chemical_id, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "YearsSinceBurn",
    y = "Concentration"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```

## Task 5 – GLM: Chemicals Significantly Affected by Years Since Burn

```{r task5-glm, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(broom)

# Fit a separate GLM for each chemical
glm_results <- jun_long |>
  nest(data = -chemical_id) |>
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ glm(concentration ~ years_since_burn, data = .x)),
    tidied = map(model, tidy)
  ) |>
  unnest(tidied)

# Filter only the slope term AND only significant chemicals
significant_chems <- glm_results |>
  filter(term == "years_since_burn", p.value < 0.05) |>
  arrange(p.value)

significant_chems
```
